description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade procedures and device initialization functions for OpenWRT firmware, including handling of UBI partitions, environment variables, and device-specific upgrade steps.

methods.name: xiaomi_initramfs_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the initramfs environment for Xiaomi devices by formatting UBI partitions if rootfs is in tmpfs.

methods.name: asus_initial_setup
methods.description: Removes existing Linux and JFFS2 volumes from UBI storage.

methods.name: remove_oem_ubi_volume
methods.description: Removes OEM-specific UBI volume based on provided volume name.

methods.name: tplink_get_boot_part
methods.description: Determines the active root filesystem partition for TP-Link devices based on kernel command-line or U-Boot environment.

methods.name: tplink_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade on TP-Link devices, switching UBI partitions accordingly.

methods.name: linksys_mx_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Pre-upgrade steps for Linksys devices, managing boot partitions and environment variables.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Always returns success, indicating the image is suitable for the device.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific preparations before firmware upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade logic that selects device-specific upgrade procedures based on board name.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configuration to persistent storage after upgrade where necessary.
